card.name: Large counts before a counted item
card.fires_on: The word million (or billion, or a final digit) ending a large number, right before the thing being counted, such as bricks, gallons, pounds, rounds or visits. It shows up in general web text, not in dosing text.

modes.label: Million or billion
modes.description: The scale word after a number, just before a counted noun.
modes.example: Approximately eight<< million>> bricks went into the building's construction.

modes.label: Final digit of a number
modes.description: The last digit of a large figure, followed by a unit such as pounds or heads.
modes.example: this group of high school kids picked 2,74<<5>> pounds of broccoli

card.writes: It pushes toward the countable item or measure noun that comes next, such as a bottle, a towel or a unit of money, rather than container words.
card.plain: It marks the end of a big number, just before the thing being counted is named.
